title: XTP dev30 diagnostics and durable Queue Fabric receipt gate
summary: XTP dev30 fixes stale control/stream reliability and limits DIAG amplification/information leakage. None of these transport signals is an authenticated remote Queue Fabric UOW. Queue Fabric XTP receipt-gate candidate1 is locally mock-qualified, not a fully authenticated channel.
invariants: Preserve Queue Fabric queue.fabric/0.9 and encrypted authenticated queue.transport/2, with ordinary TCP/TLS and other sockets working unchanged.
QueueChannelFabric~pump ACKs its transmission queue on transport~deliver success. XTP CNTL, multicast quorum, DIAG or timeout must never be returned as durable Queue Fabric success.

XTP dev29 introduced SYNC/ECHO for context-scoped unicast streams and DIAG code 1 for refusal; dev30 bounds DIAG size to the provoking packet, limits replies per host and globally, and emits reason VALUE name only.

Source-binding, KEY return-bit and SYNC/ECHO do not constitute queue.transport/2 peer authentication. Transport or DIAG failure may still leave application commit outcome ambiguous; use RELEASE/reconcile.

The standalone QueueXtpReceiptGate requires an injected verifier to authenticate a remote committed receipt and checks transferId, queueName, sourceManager and durable markers before returning success.

Local r13196 mock tests passed 13 assertions for the downloadable candidate ZIP (sha256 9a33b2df21d436639de3ba5f2ef17c97bd04ddbdf51c8eb7dd735a40281da032); independent GitHub candidate Autobuild still needs acceptance.
Actual queue.transport/2 over XTP dev30, bidirectional reply correlation, durable queue restart, multicast per-manager receipts, Planner ticket/WLU gating and ED209 field routes are not qualified.
XTP DIAG numeric allocation is owned by XTP dev30 docs/DIAG_REGISTRY.md; this sphere does not change it.

provenance.claim: dev30 transport changes; not a Queue Fabric acceptance witness.
Pump ACK follows transport deliver success at source line 600 to 609.
Standalone local r13196 candidate with mock verifier, not a cryptographic network acceptance.
